title: CBI v. Sanjeev Chawla & Hansie Cronje (Cricket Match Fixing Conspiracy)
crime_type: Transnational Sports Fraud / Underworld Syndicate Bookmaking / Hawala Bribery
court_or_authority: Patiala House Sessions Court, New Delhi / UK High Court of Justice Extradition
source: Delhi Police Crime Branch & UK High Court Judgment
location: New Delhi, Mumbai, India & London, United Kingdom
evidence: Intercepted audio recordings of phone conversations between Sanjeev Chawla and Hansie Cronje in Delhi hotel discussing pitch conditions and run-scoring limits
Transnational wire transfers and cash delivery logs in luxury hotel suites in Taj Palace New Delhi
Admissions before the King Judicial Commission of Inquiry in South Africa acknowledging acceptance of ,000+ bribes
Successful extradition ruling by the UK High Court of Justice after nineteen years of legal evasion
modus_operandi: Approached national sports team captain through middleman bookmakers. Offered lavish cash payments, leather jackets, and jewelry to manipulate team selections, pitch reports, run rates, and match outcomes in bilateral international cricket series to guarantee massive bookmaking betting profits.
personality_disorder: Cynical transnational commercial exploitation, covert syndicate maneuvering, and sports integrity subversion.
common_traits: Telecom audio wiretaps capturing match manipulation negotiations
Bribery of high-integrity team leadership figures
Hawala cash deliveries inside 5-star hotel sanctuaries
summary: The biggest corruption scandal in international cricket history. Delhi Police audio intercepts shattered the perceived sanctity of sports integrity, leading to the establishment of the ICC Anti-Corruption Unit (ACU) and landmark UK-India extradition precedents.
